access.title: Vault settings
access.subtitle: Retention and policies for this vault.
access.retention_help: This only removes Local Copies from the vault folder. Cloud Archive Versions stay recoverable. Automatic cleanup is off until you enable it.
access.retention_example: Example: with 45 days, a Local Copy may be removed 45 days after its matching Archive Version is verified, or 45 days after the file was last written locally, whichever is later. A recovered or edited file starts a fresh window.
access.retention_never: Cleanup is queued, then rechecks the exact fingerprint before deleting. If the local file changed, it is left alone. Manual Free local space remains available.
access.retention_days: Retention after verification or last local change (days)
access.retention_days_help: Changing this value recalculates eligibility during the next vault scan. Manual cleanup remains available.
access.retention_days_required: Enter at least one retention day before enabling automatic cleanup.
access.policy_help: Automatic upload is enabled for new Vaults. Files are queued after five minutes without changes; full scans reconcile missed events. Pausing stops new automatic uploads, not verification already in progress.
access.policy_auto_upload: Enable automatic upload for this Vault
access.policy_fixed_exclusions: Always excluded from automatic upload: .DS_Store, Thumbs.db, ._*, *.lock, *-wal, *-journal. Include rules cannot override these fixed exclusions.
access.policy_include_help: Include patterns. Empty means every Local Copy is eligible. Example: reports/** or *.pdf
access.policy_exclude_help: Exclude patterns always win. A file matching both include and exclude is not auto-uploaded. Example: tmp/** or **/*.tmp
access.policy_preview_help: Paste a few vault-relative paths to see which current patterns would include or skip. This does not save the policy.
access.policy_preview_skipped_exclude: Would be skipped by an exclude rule.
access.policy_preview_skipped_include: Would be skipped: fixed noise exclusion or no matching include rule.
access.cloud_deletion_help: Cloud deletion is off by default. Permanent purge requires confirmation and has a cancellable delay. Local files are untouched.
access.cloud_deletion_enabled_state: Cloud deletion is enabled for this vault.

decommission.title: Decommission Vault
decommission.description: Review and explicitly choose what happens to {vault} before its local root is released.
decommission.owner_panel_help: This is separate from disabling the Vault. The root remains reserved until every selected disposition is verified.
decommission.local_retain_help: Leave every local file untouched when the root is released.
decommission.local_remove_help: Use verified free-space protections to remove only Local Copies that exactly match available Archive Versions.
decommission.cloud_retain_help: Keep Archive Versions, Delete Markers, and the cloud namespace.
decommission.cloud_purge_help: Use the permanent-purge delay and exact provider-version deletion protections. This cannot be undone after deletion begins.
decommission.tombstone_help: The Vault tombstone, Jobs, Vault File identity, Path History, and audit history remain recorded.
decommission.confirmation_mismatch: The confirmation must match the exact Vault name, including case.
decommission.root_released: The local root has been atomically released. The Vault remains as a tombstone.
decommission.root_reserved: The local root remains reserved until both dispositions are terminal and verified.

access.plan_help: One plan applies to the whole Vault. Changing it never deletes cloud content or moves files immediately.
access.plan_standard_only_help: Stay in Standard: immediate access without retrieval fees; highest storage cost.
access.plan_economical_help: Standard-IA at day 30, Glacier Instant Retrieval at day 90: immediate access with lower storage cost, retrieval fees and 30/90-day minimum billing.
access.plan_archive_tiered_help: Standard-IA at day 30, Glacier Instant Retrieval at day 90, Deep Archive at day 365: progressively cheaper storage; after day 365 recovery takes hours and has retrieval fees and 180-day minimum billing.
access.plan_deep_archive_early_help: Deep Archive at day 0 (next AWS lifecycle evaluation): lowest storage cost, recovery in hours with retrieval fees; replacement or deletion before 180 days still incurs minimum storage charges.
access.plan_custom_help: Ordered steps are object ages since upload, not delays between steps. IA starts at day 30; leave at least 30 days in IA and 90 in Glacier Instant Retrieval or Glacier Flexible Retrieval before a colder step. Transition and retrieval fees and minimum billing apply.
access.plan_sync_pending: Plan saved; cloud synchronization is pending and will retry during reconciliation.
access.plan_invalid: Use increasing nonnegative whole days and colder classes. IA requires day 30 and 30 days residence; Glacier Instant/Flexible Retrieval requires 90 days before a colder step. One Zone-IA cannot transition to Glacier Instant Retrieval.
access.plan_caveats: AWS applies transitions asynchronously based on object age; existing older objects may transition soon. Objects below 128 KB stay in their class by default. Early replacement can incur minimum-duration charges. There are no expiration or noncurrent-version rules; a warmer plan does not restore already cold content. One Zone-IA uses a single Availability Zone.
